text:
maya: quick brain dump - thinking about a "slice ramp + affinity" rollout model. core idea: partition by tenant into N slices, ramp slice-local traffic instead of global pct, and include two-tier fallback: immediate router short-circuit for local flash, and controller-driven persistent rollback if aggregated signals persist.

ajay: good direction. cache warmup + session affinity are the tricky parts. switching mid-session screws KV locality and increases tail p95.

sam: agree. propose session-affinity cookie/header with TTL (e.g., 10m) so active sessions stay on their variant during ramp.

liz: plus we need smoothing on signals. raw 1m p95 is noisy. evaluation window (5m p95) + debounce (2m) feels safer.

nora: placement question: router-level guards vs central controller. router is fast but local; controller is global but slower.

ajay: hybrid pattern: router enforces emergency guardrails (short-circuit if local p95 > threshold), controller reconciles global view to mutate slice targets. router guard flips should be ephemeral and not write long-term state.

maya: sketched config shape: pilot_slices=128; slice_selector=tenant_id % slices; rollout: steps: 1%, 3%, 10%, 25% w/ step_duration=15m; session_affinity_ttl=600s; fallback_criteria: p95_ms>300 OR err_pct>1.5 over eval_window=300s; router_local_guard: p95_ms>450 OR err_pct>5.0 for immediate short-circuit.

liz: add reserved golden pool (2-5% traffic) excluded from pilot to keep a clean baseline. also rate-limit alerts when router guard fires repeatedly.

sam: warmup probe idea: mark slice as "warm-required" and run model-specific probes (kv + short seq) before increasing traffic. probe pass => slice warm.

maya: probe should be synthetic and exercise common hot paths, and ship probe result as a metric (probe_success).

nora: multi-variant fanout case (rerank + generator) needs variant tagging for traces so we can attribute which step regressed. router should add headers with variant IDs and slice.

ajay: implementation constraint: keep routers stateless. store only affinity token in header + tiny LRU cache for very recent flips. controller writes targets to config store; routers poll every few seconds.

maya: ops commands: `/pilot pause <id>`, `/pilot rollback <id>`, `/pilot promote <id>`; all actions write audit entries.

deploy-bot: rolling deploy maya/pilot-slice-ramp -> model-v6 started (slices=128 initial=1%).

liz: runbook item: if router-local guard trips for 3 consecutive windows, escalate pager. also include a cool-off period to prevent flip-flop.

sam: test plan: unit tests for router decision, integration tests with injected latency/errors, e2e warmup+golden checks. include chaos tests flipping affinity TTL mid-session.

maya: telemetry notes: avoid per-tenant explosion. emit per-slice aggregates (p95, err_pct, cache_miss) and sample per-tenant traces only when anomalous.

ajay: also capture cache-miss-rate per-slice during ramp to detect warmup problems before latency spikes.

nora: controller reconciliation should compute persisted slice assignments, but routers should have an emergency opcode to short-circuit traffic locally. controller can revert or promote based on aggregated signals and golden comparisons.

maya: action items: 1) i'll draft RFC with config shape + responsibilities, 2) router guard PR prototype, 3) controller reconcile PR, 4) observability dashboard (per-slice), 5) runbook + emergency commands. owner: maya. deadline: next tuesday.

liz: +1. cc platform and observability.

sam: small follow-up: consider backing off ramp speed when cache_miss_rate > threshold instead of outright rollback to preserve progress.

maya: good call. add soft-backoff policy before hard rollback.

nora: sounds solid. we'll loop in infra for config store polling rates and secret handling for affinity tokens.

maya: thanks all. quick sync next week to finalize thresholds. :thumbsup:
